title: A(I)nimism: Re-enchanting the World Through AI-Mediated Object Interaction
reasoning: The paper explores 'techno-spirituality' and 'spiritual HCI' by using animism and Shintoism as frameworks for AI interaction. It evaluates how LLMs can mediate spiritual relationships with objects and incorporates religious concepts like 'kami' and 'sacred gateways' into its core system design and evaluation.
